{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, verify that revenue is indeed string type
print(f'Revenue dtype before conversion: {df["revenue"].dtype}')

# Replace commas and convert to float
df["revenue"] = df["revenue"].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check the first few values after conversion
print(f'Revenue values after conversion (first 5): {df["revenue"].head().tolist()}')

# Confirm the dtype is now float
print(f'Revenue dtype after conversion: {df["revenue"].dtype}')"}
